videos.title: Full Stack Rust Webapp + Docker Image Build
videos.description: This video details structuring a full-stack Rust project, covering Environment setup, Hot Reloading with Trunk, and serving a Single Page Application using Actix Web. It also demonstrates building and running a Docker image for deployment purposes.

videos.title: Build Blazing Fast Backends with Rust & Actix Web
videos.description: Learn to build blazing-fast and safe backends with Rust and the Actix Web framework. This step-by-step guide walks you through creating a basic web server from scratch, covering essential concepts like setting up the server, defining endpoints with GET and POST methods, and…

videos.title: Learning Rust: Web Server with Actix Web
videos.description: This video provides an overview of creating a basic web server using the actix-web framework in Rust. It covers the fundamental steps for setting up a server, drawing from and adapting existing actix-web examples to demonstrate the process.
